webster.text: Careful; anxious; very desirous, as to obtain something.

example.quote: When relieved from the apprehensions of losing that great advantage, they are solicitous of securing a superiority of influence in the national councils.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
